request.question:
Which non-test modules are never imported by another file in the repository? Leave out package __init__.py files, __main__.py files and the Alembic migration directory.

Requested output columns: file_id (string).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. After executing SQL, describe the returned rows and query assumptions. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.
request.evidence: Only imports that resolve to a file count. Python runs a package's __init__.py whenever a submodule is imported; __main__.py files are run with python -m or as a console script (the code map holds only Python files, so pyproject [project.scripts] entries are not read; at this commit the only one, in mcp/pyproject.toml, points at a __main__.py); Alembic loads alembic/ from its script_location. Scripts run directly by path, such as files under dev_tools/, are still listed.

gold_sql:
SELECT f.file_id
FROM code.files f
WHERE NOT f.is_test
  AND right('/' || f.file_id, 12) NOT IN ('/__init__.py', '/__main__.py')
  AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'alembic/%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i
    WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND i.file_id <> f.file_id
  )
ORDER BY f.file_id;
